findings.text: The added 58-line script reproduces scripts/prototypes/bank_solve_driver/negative_control.py almost verbatim, differing only in its SOURCE, MUTATION and selected test id, so the scratch-mutation harness now has two copies that must be maintained in step.

Three maxima are rounded one unit high in the last printed digit against h200-frozen-final.log — axis gap 5.0035e-11 against the log's 5.003442614e-11 (5.0034e-11), X-point gap 3.2308e-11 against 3.230702068e-11 (3.2307e-11), and the 9.8496e-11 fresh-residual maximum repeated at :62 against 9.849543403e-11 (9.8495e-11) — so the record does not exactly reconcile with the log it cites, although each error overstates the gap and changes no budget decision.

The added "& ~changed" acceptance guard cannot fire, because changed is recomputed at :1605 from the same carried reading that drift already cleared at :1686 before frozen was carried forward, so the fragment-switch protection the tests actually exercise is the drift term and this guard is unexercised logic.
The gate receipt names only the revision, tree and command, with no partition or job id, so the done-when clause that the CPU tests passed on sirius cannot be confirmed from the log itself.
